# Production rules

| Output | Adaptation |
| --- | --- |
| Web | Semantic HTML, responsive layout, visible focus, readable controls, reduced-motion override; test real composited backgrounds. |
| PowerPoint | Prefer editable text and shapes, 16:9 unless specified, minimum 24 pt body; simplify blur, texture and chrome. Verify exported slides. |
| Word / PDF | Reading-first hierarchy, accessible heading levels, printable contrast, repeat table headers, sensible pagination. Verify actual pages and PDF text order where possible. |
| Social graphic | Confirm channel and dimensions or label an assumed square draft; maintain safe margins and mobile-readable type. Supply alternate text. |

Required content takes priority over decorative style. For long copy, grow the layout or use multiple pages/slides; do not silently omit text or shrink it until unreadable. Avoid image-based body text when editable text is supported. Do not add invented metrics, approvals, claims or sources.

The 25 profiles are original interpretations. Names describe visual directions, not recovered code, licensed fonts or exact reproductions. Use a consistent palette and essential traits rather than layering every possible effect.

Contrast must reflect foreground alpha and the background beneath it. Gradients, blur, shadows, textured backgrounds and imagery require rendered review. Normal text target 4.5:1; large text 3:1. Check non-text controls separately. A ratio alone does not establish full compliance.
